title: ASP.NET Core Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Make a minimal route
entries.summary: MapGet connects a GET path to a function. Open GET /.
notes: MapGet only handles matching GET requests.

entries.name: Return a data object
entries.summary: Results.Json sends structured data as JSON. Open GET /book.
notes: Use objects for data instead of joining JSON text by hand.

entries.name: Read a path input
entries.summary: Curly braces name a route value. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
notes: Do not place user text into raw HTML without escaping it.

entries.name: Constrain a route number
entries.summary: The int route constraint only matches whole numbers. Open GET /double/4.
notes: A failed route constraint usually means this route does not match.

entries.name: Read an optional query
entries.summary: A simple input outside the path can come from the query string. GET /page with no n uses the fallback.
notes: A missing optional number is null, not automatically zero.

entries.name: Read a JSON record
entries.summary: A record can describe body data. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: A type describes shape; add checks for values that must not be empty.

entries.name: Check a body value
entries.summary: The handler checks a title before returning a created response. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: Minimal APIs in this version do not make every custom validation rule for you.

entries.name: Add a shared response rule
entries.summary: Middleware can run before and after later handlers. GET /note carries the header set here.
notes: Call next when the request should continue through the pipeline.

entries.name: Group related paths
entries.summary: MapGroup gives several routes one common prefix. Open GET /api/books.
notes: The group prefix is part of each final route.

entries.name: Receive a shared helper
entries.summary: A registered service can be an input to a handler. Open GET /school.
notes: Register services before building the app.

entries.name: Return a missing-item reply
entries.summary: Results.NotFound gives a 404 response. Open GET /missing.
notes: Use the error status as well as a helpful message.

entries.name: Point a client elsewhere
entries.summary: Results.Redirect sends a location. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
notes: A redirect asks the client to make a second request.
